# @cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1)

[LowCode Engine](https://github.com/alibaba/lowcode-engine) materials of
[Ant Design Vue 1](https://1x.antdv.com/docs/vue/introduce-cn/) (`ant-design-vue` 1.7.8) for **Vue 2.7**, rendered by
`@cdlab996/lowcode-vue2`.

<!-- Generated by scripts/materials/readme.cjs: edit the script, not this file. -->

## Components

94 components: every component documented by `ant-design-vue` 1.7.8 (the last 1.x release, the last one supporting Vue 2)
has a meta, with the props, events and slots of [its docs](https://1x.antdv.com/docs/vue/introduce-cn/),
a snippet and a `docUrl` to its page.

`Card.Grid` has no documented props in 1.x and no meta.

- The metas are generated from the docs of that version (`scripts/materials`,
  see CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository); `ant-design-vue` is pinned to 1.7.8.
- `tests/meta.test.ts` checks them against the components of that version:
  declared props, handler names, doc links, code generation exports and
  screenshots.
- `screenshots/` holds a thumbnail of every component, rendered from its
  snippet in the designer canvas; components with nothing to show (modals,
  sub-components) use `screenshots/fallback.svg`.

## Usage

The package ships browser builds; the designer loads them through
`assets.json`. The canvas must run Vue 2.7 with the
`@cdlab996/lowcode-vue2` simulator.

From a CDN (unpkg serves the published `dist`):

```ts
import { injectAssets } from '@alilc/lowcode-plugin-inject'
import type { IPublicModelPluginContext } from '@alilc/lowcode-types'

const editorInit = (ctx: IPublicModelPluginContext) => ({
  async init() {
    const assets = await injectAssets(
      'https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1/dist/assets.json',
    )
    await ctx.material.setAssets(assets)
  },
})
editorInit.pluginName = 'editorInit'
```

From the installed package (`pnpm add @cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1`), serve its `dist`
yourself and pass the imported JSON with your own URLs:

```ts
import assets from '@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1/dist/assets.json'
```

In the designer of this repository, the material is built in; any other
material is added by pasting its `assets.json` URL into the 物料 panel.

## Files

- `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.css`: the components, as
  `window.Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsAntdVue1`
- `dist/meta.js`: the metas, as `window.Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsAntdVue1Meta`
- `dist/assets.json`: the engine assets pointing at the two, with the
  `codegen` manifest
- `dist/screenshots/`: snippet thumbnails

The scripts, the styles and `assets.json` also come minified (`.min`).
`assets.json` of a release:

```json
{
  "version": "<version>",
  "packages": [
    {
      "package": "@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1",
      "version": "<version>",
      "library": "Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsAntdVue1",
      "urls": [
        "https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1@<version>/dist/index.css",
        "https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1@<version>/dist/index.js"
      ],
      "codegen": {
        "exports": { "...": "component -> export of ant-design-vue" },
        "styles": ["..."],
        "dependencies": { "ant-design-vue": "1.7.8" }
      }
    }
  ],
  "components": [
    {
      "exportName": "Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsAntdVue1Meta",
      "url": "https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1@<version>/dist/meta.js",
      "package": { "npm": "@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-antd-vue1" }
    }
  ],
  "sort": { "groupList": [], "categoryList": [] }
}
```

The `codegen` manifest is what the code generator
(`@cdlab996/lowcode-code-generator`) uses to import the components from
`ant-design-vue` in generated projects.

## Development

```bash
pnpm -C packages/materials/antd-vue1 build   # dist/
pnpm dev --watch antd-vue1   # from the repository root: rebuild on change, next to the designer
```
